items.q: What counts as a 'campaign' in plan limits?
items.a: A campaign is a structure in Google Ads or Meta Ads with a single objective (e.g. leads for course A, sales of product B, traffic to landing C). Ad sets and creative variations within the same campaign do not count separately.

items.q: Do I need to hire both Google and Meta? Can I do just one?

items.a: It is a proprietary Agathas plugin connecting your WordPress site to Google Ads, Meta Ads and our reporting system. It captures leads, fires conversion events and integrates with your CRM/WhatsApp automatically.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Get answers about plans, messaging and rollout.

items.q: Do you use the Official WhatsApp API?
items.a: Yes. Voyia is integrated directly with Meta's WhatsApp Business Cloud API — no QR code, no ban risk and full official features (templates, buttons, flows, etc.).

items.q: How are Meta message fees charged?
items.a: Meta charges for business-initiated messages (marketing, utility, authentication). Voyia passes these rates through without markup. Customer-initiated service messages and replies within the 24-hour window are free.

items.q: Can I migrate my current number?
items.a: Yes. We handle full migration from WhatsApp Business App or any other platform to Voyia, with end-to-end support during Meta verification.

items.q: Is there a lock-in or cancellation fee?
items.a: No. You can cancel any time without penalty. Annual plans get 20% off while keeping full flexibility.

items.q: Do you help configure the chatbot?
items.a: We provide complete documentation, videos and step-by-step tutorials so you can configure the chatbot yourself — the panel is built for self-sufficiency. If you'd rather have Agathas do the personalised configuration for you, we offer that as a dedicated service for an additional fee, quoted by flow scope.

items.q: How does the AI integration work?
items.a: Voyia connects to the AI model you pick (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.) using your own API key — you decide whether to use the provider's free or paid plan. Voyia orchestrates the conversation, keeps context and hands off to a human when needed; the model cost stays directly between you and the AI provider, with no markup.
Servers in Brazil with multi-tenant isolation, Meta tokens encrypted with AES-256 and OWASP Top 10 hardening. GDPR-compatible.

metadata.title: Refund Policy | Agathas Web
metadata.description: Agathas Web's refund policy for digital services and products, including Voyia and paid traffic management.

refundPolicy.title: Refund
refundPolicy.intro: This Refund Policy describes the conditions for refund requests on services and digital products offered by Agathas Web, including the Voyia platform, paid traffic management, hosting and other digital products.

sections.heading: 1. General Provisions
sections.body: Under Brazilian consumer protection law (CDC Art. 49), consumers may withdraw from contracts entered into outside a physical store — including online purchases — within 7 calendar days from sign-up or service delivery, without justification. International customers are subject to the same 7-day cooling-off window. This policy details how that right applies to each service category.

sections.heading: 2. Voyia (WhatsApp Business API)
sections.body: For monthly and annual subscriptions to the Voyia platform:
bullets: Full refund within 7 calendar days of sign-up, provided the Official API configuration with Meta has not yet been completed.

After your WhatsApp number is approved by Meta (a process started at the customer's request), refunds become prorated for unused time in the contracted month, deducting any messaging fees already charged by Meta.
Annual plans cancelled after 7 days are refunded prorated for unused months, deducting the difference between the discounted annual rate and the full monthly rate for already-consumed months.
Meta messaging fees (marketing, utility, authentication) already consumed are non-refundable, as they are passed through directly to Meta with no Agathas markup.

sections.heading: 3. Paid Traffic Management
sections.body: For monthly campaign management fees (Google Ads and/or Meta Ads):
bullets: Full refund within 7 calendar days of sign-up, provided technical setup (plugin configuration, GTM, CAPI and dashboards) has not yet begun.
After setup begins, refunds are prorated, deducting technical hours already invested (minimum of R$ 350 for setup).
To cancel an ongoing contract, a 30-day notice is required to wrap up reporting cycles, hand back access and transition. There is no cancellation penalty.
Media spend (budget paid directly to Google and Meta) is not charged by Agathas and is therefore not subject to refund from Agathas — any remaining balance in the ad account belongs to the customer.

sections.heading: 4. Hosting Products
sections.body: For Moodle hosting and managed hosting services:
bullets: Full refund within 7 calendar days of sign-up, provided the environment has not yet been provisioned.
After provisioning, prorated refunds apply for unused time, deducting setup fees and third-party licences already acquired.
Costs for domains registered in the customer's name, paid SSL certificates and premium plugin/theme licences are non-refundable.

sections.heading: 5. Development and Consultancy Services
sections.body: Custom development projects and consultancy follow specific contractual conditions stated in each project's service agreement. Generally:
bullets: Upfront deposit (typically 30% to 50% of project value) is non-refundable once work has effectively begun.
Instalments for milestones already validated and accepted by the customer are non-refundable.
If cancelled mid-project, the technical work performed up to the cancellation date will be charged proportionally.

sections.heading: 6. How to Request a Refund
sections.body: To request a refund, email webmaster@agathas.com.br with: invoice number, reason for the request and deposit details (bank, account, holder ID). Review takes up to 5 business days; approved refunds are processed within 10 business days via bank transfer or card reversal (according to original payment method).

sections.heading: 7. Exclusions
bullets: Meta messages already consumed (pass-through with no markup).
Paid media spend (Google Ads, Meta Ads) — paid directly to the platforms.
Third-party licences (premium plugins, themes, certificates, domains).
Technical hours already executed on custom projects.
Sign-ups older than 7 days where the service has already been used and validated by the customer.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: This policy may be updated to reflect changes in products, regulations or market conditions. Previous versions are available on request. The version in force at the time of sign-up governs the contractual relationship.
